design_detail: a fair tax on wealth and capital income, within a new fiscal pact
quote_original: implementar un nuevo pacto fiscal que grave de manera justa la riqueza y las rentas de capital
quote_en: implement a new fiscal pact that fairly taxes wealth and capital income
source_title: El 1 % más rico de la población dominicana concentra ingresos equivalentes a los de 8 millones de personas
grading_note: Reporter's account of her call on El Día (Telesistema) presenting Oxfam's 'Riqueza sin control' report; says 'riqueza' without naming a net-wealth tax, so C.

design_detail: 'Impuesto a la Fortuna' above the equivalent of US$1 million, on income, gains, financial assets or rents
quote_original: Debe existir una Impuesto a la Fortuna, para los ingresos, ganancias, activos financieros o rentas por sobre un monto a establecer pero que nunca debe ser inferior al equivalente a un millón de dólares.
quote_en: There must be a Fortune Tax, on income, gains, financial assets or rents above an amount to be set that must never be below the equivalent of one million dollars.
grading_note: Own column. The base mixes income, gains and financial assets, so it may be an income surcharge; the tax is named after fortunes and the same column says the income tax should tax wealth more. C.
